Dave Matthews Band
July 24, 2021
PNC Music Pavilion Charlotte - Charlotte, NC

**** THIS IS A 24 BIT RECORDING, NOT INTENDED FOR CD BURNING ***
*** The normal 16 bit CD quality version of this show is available for download/CD burning ***

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > Zoom F6 (32 Bit Float WAV)
Location: LOB & DFC, Mics XY ~9'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.32 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing) > FLAC (Level 8) > Audacity 3.0.2 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

01. Intro
02. Seek Up
03. When the World Ends
04. Proudest Monkey (Tease) > Satellite
05. Sweet Up and Down
06. So Much to Say >
07. Anyone Seen the Bridge@ >
08. Too Much
09. Dave Speak: New Album
10. Walk Around the Moon
11. You & Me
12. You Never Know
13. Where Are You Going$
14. Squirm >
15. Funny the Way It Is%
16. Lying in the Hands of God*
17. Raven
18. If Only
19. Seven
20. The Space Between
21. Rooftop
22. Band Intro & Crew Thank You
23. Tripping Billies
24. Encore Break
25. Dave Speak: Seattle & Italy
26. Singing from the Windows
27. Don't Drink the Water^ >
28. Shake Me Like a Monkey

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

@ includes "Also Sprach Zarathustra" and "Heartbreaker" interpolations
$ includes extended prelude with Dave Speak
% short "Come Tomorrow" tease
* includes "Bourbons & Lacs" and "American Baby Intro" interpolations
^ includes prelude and "This Land Is Your Land" interpolation

Audible balloon pops can be heard during the show.

Huge thanks to the DMB Crew for letting me set up at FOH.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers before me who continue to preserve live music.

Compiled on 2021/07/25
